proposals.evidence: Turner indhana fuel gives Punjabi innhaṇ and Hindi ī̃dhan. The Gojri/Kaithal firewood responses fit this fuel-noun family with local denasalization and deaspiration; they are not the questionable Kalasha tripod sense mentioned in the same entry.
